PRo american roofing 15+ Years of Industry Leading Experience Servicing All of Dallas - Fort Worth Metroplex About Pro American Roofing 5 stars with 93 reviews Years of Experience 0 + At Pro American Roofing, we are dedicated to providing top-quality roofing solutions for our customers across the nation. With years of experience in the industry, our skilled team of professionals is committed to delivering excellence in every project we undertake. We pride ourselves on our commitment to exceptional craftsmanship, using only the highest quality materials to ensure durable and long-lasting roofs. Whether it’s residential or commercial roofing needs, we offer a wide range of services, including roof installations, repairs, replacements, and maintenance. Our mission is to exceed customer expectations by delivering outstanding service, reliability, and integrity. We strive to build strong, long-term relationships with our clients, based on trust and satisfaction. Pro American Roofing is licensed, insured, and dedicated to adhering to the highest standards of safety and professionalism. When you choose Pro American Roofing, you can expect personalized attention, timely project completion, and competitive pricing. We are here to protect your property and provide peace of mind with our superior roofing solutions. Contact us today to experience the Pro American Roofing difference. Contact Us Happy Clients 0 + Cups of Coffee 0 + Perfect Installs Your roof is your home’s main defense against the elements. Let us walk you through the best options to fit your needs and once you feel comfortable with your choice, we’ll handle the complete installation. Reliable Upgrades If you’re looking to update or upgrade your roofing and gutters, we’ve got you covered. Book a free consultation to discuss our six different types of roofing composition and environmentally friendly options! Upkeep & Repair Age and environmental factors can wreak havoc on your roof. Ignoring problems for too long can cause headaches down the road. Start with a free inspection today! testimonials What people say about Pro American Roofing After several hail storms and multiple denials by our insurance company, all the while watching our neighbors get new roofs, Pro American Roofing, LLC was finally able to get us approved. They were honest and above board in doing so, unlike another company we decided not to use. Robert, Christian, and Christian were a pleasure to work with. They explained the procedure that would occur in working with our insurance company and mortgage company, and they told us exactly what we needed to do in order to avoid delays. They also made a special trip to our house to double check our choice of material and color. The materials and workers arrived at our house very early on the day the roof was to be installed, and they completed the job in one day. Afterwards they cleaned up all the old shingles and roofing materials before they left. Finally, they managed to save us a considerable amount of money. We are more than satisfied with the job they did for us and are pleased to recommend them without reservation. Sherry F. Grand Prairie, TX My dad had a new roof installed by Pro American Roofing. Having been through the process before with other companies, not only was he extremely satisfied with the outcome, but he referred me and we recently decided to do our new roof through them as well. They were outstanding in every aspect. Christian was responsive to all of my questions and basically held our hand through the entire insurance process. They are also Spanish friendly and were able to explain the process to my husband. They were attentive and thorough throughout. The crews cleanliness during the install was also top tier and it only took one full day for completion. I will be recommending them to anyone looking to have their roof replaced or even just needing an evaluation. The entire team is extremely knowledgeable. Mayra V. reviews.text: Last year, after hail damaged my roof, I worked with Pro American, and they did an excellent job. Alex assisted with the insurance claim, making the process smooth and stress-free. The team was professional, punctual, and the repair work was top-notch. I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Eric Chavez

reviews.text: Recently had my roof replaced, Alex and his team did a phenomenal job. Highly recommend for all your roofing needs and will definitely use them in the future should the need arise! 😃
reviews.author: James Kingman

reviews.text: Pro American Roofing did an outstanding job replacing our roof. Alex the project manager did an outstanding service by taking lots of pictures and doing a thorough inspection of the entire roof. We had a leak and he found the source. We didn’t have to do much of anything he handled the entire process from start to finish. Thank you for an amazing and easy experience.
reviews.author: Jesus Davalos

reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience with Pro American Roofing! I had the pleasure of working with Alex, the project manager and I am grateful for his help and knowledge. He kept me informed at every step of the process and was always there to answer any questions or concerns.
reviews.author: Cinthia C

reviews.text:
This is an AMAZING Roofing company. It is difficult to choose a company that is honest and that you 100% trust with your home or even know what they are doing. This company does. especially Alex. So grateful for his help and the amazing work he has done to my roof.
100% would recommend you won't regret it.
reviews.author: Brian Demetrio

reviews.text: Pro American roofing was great to work with, Alex was our project manager and made sure we were taken care of promptly and professionally every step of the way.
reviews.author: Mike P

reviews.text: Highly recommend going through pro American roofing for any roof replacement along with any cosmetic damage. Thank you Alex (project manager) for assisting me and being so helpful throughout the process!
reviews.author: Kelvyn Reyes

reviews.text:
My boy Alex Castillo came into the rescue when I was in need for a new gutter system

Didn't even know where to begin with this whole project and then Alex immediately pointed me into the right direction to get this done in a timely and affordable matter

Highly recommend this company to anyone looking for more than just a roof!!!

data.summary: The reviews show strong patterns of inauthenticity. All Google reviews are perfect 5-star ratings posted within a short period, heavily feature the same employee, and lack any negative or nuanced feedback. The absence of reviews on other major platforms is suspicious for a 3-year-old business. While the BBB accreditation is positive, the overall review profile appears manipulated.
fake_signals: All 8 sampled Google reviews are 5-star and posted within a narrow timeframe (a year ago to 11 months ago)
Multiple reviews mention the same employee (Alex) in near-identical glowing terms
Lack of any critical or constructive feedback across all platforms
No reviews found on major contractor platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz, Trustpilot) despite being in business for 3 years
Writing styles are similar: short, generic praise focused on 'Alex' and 'process'
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific contexts like hail damage or gutter replacement
BBB shows A+ rating and accreditation since 2023
data.discrepancy_explanation: Perfect 5.0 Google rating with only 12 reviews contrasts with no reviews on Yelp, Angi, Houzz, or Trustpilot. BBB rating is high but based on accreditation, not customer reviews. This suggests potential review solicitation or platform manipulation.
